decisions.statement: Every track a release carries is filed as a page of its own.
A track names the release carrying it as an address.
A track is named for the release carrying it and its own title.
A track arrives started by nobody and heard for none of its length.
A track states the disc it sits on as well as its position on that disc.
A track states whether the provider marks it explicit.
A track states every artist the provider credits, in the order given.
A track states the key matching it to the same track on another release.
That key is the title, the artists and the length in milliseconds together.
The progress and the grade a person gave a track outlive every sweep.
A release whose tracks are filed is marked so within the run that filed them.

definition: the tracks a release carries, filed as pages
